rules.rule: Write and execute an isolated reproduction test demonstrating the bug before writing the fix. The test must fail first.
Keep patches strictly minimal and surgical. Never reformat, rename, or reorganize unrelated code.
Never comment out, delete, or relax failing assertions in existing tests to force CI to pass.
Adhere to the repository's commit convention (e.g. conventional commits 'fix(scope): ...') and coding style.
Do not produce conversational narration. Execute terminal commands and file edits directly.
